title: Users
author: ViraStack <https://virastack.com>
description: A searchable user list with pagination in the URL, a shared add and edit form and row actions.

"use client"

import { PlusIcon } from "lucide-react"
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl"

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogTrigger
} from "@/components/ui/dialog"
import { AddUserForm } from "@/features/users/components/AddUserForm"

export function AddUserDialog() {
  const t = useTranslations("Users")

  return (
    <Dialog>
      <DialogTrigger render={<Button className="shrink-0" />}>
        <PlusIcon aria-hidden />
        {t("add_user")}
      </DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent className="max-h-[calc(100dvh-2rem)] max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] overflow-y-auto sm:max-w-md">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>{t("add_user")}</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>{t("add_user_description")}</DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <AddUserForm />
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  )
}

import type { UserRole } from "@/features/users/schemas/user.schema"

export const USERS_PATH = "/users"
export const USERS_PAGE_SIZE = 10
export const SEARCH_DEBOUNCE_MS = 300

export const ROLE_BADGE_CLASS_NAMES: Record<UserRole, string> = {
  admin: "border-transparent bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300",
  moderator: "border-transparent bg-indigo-500/15 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300",
  user: "border-transparent bg-muted text-foreground"
}

Users.add_user_description: Sends a real POST request to the DummyJSON demo API.
Users.add_not_saved: This user was not saved. DummyJSON is a demo API: it returns the new user but does not store it, so the user will not appear in the list.
Users.no_users_description: The API returned an empty list.
Users.validation_username_format: Use letters, numbers, dots, hyphens or underscores
Users.details_description: Shows the data already in the table, with no request.
Users.edit_description: Sends a real PUT request to the DummyJSON demo API. It stores nothing, so the change lasts until the list loads again.
Users.delete_description: Sends a real DELETE request to the DummyJSON demo API. It stores nothing, so the user comes back when the list loads again.

Users.add_user_description: DummyJSON demo API'sine gerçek bir POST isteği gönderir.
Users.add_not_saved: Bu kullanıcı kaydedilmedi. DummyJSON bir demo API: yeni kullanıcıyı döndürür ama saklamaz, bu yüzden kullanıcı listede görünmez.
Users.error_network: İstek gönderilemedi. İnternet bağlantını kontrol et.
Users.validation_username_format: Harf, rakam, nokta, tire veya alt çizgi kullan
Users.edit_description: DummyJSON demo API'sine gerçek bir PUT isteği atar. API hiçbir şey saklamaz; değişiklik liste yeniden yüklenene kadar kalır.
Users.delete_description: DummyJSON demo API'sine gerçek bir DELETE isteği atar. API hiçbir şey saklamaz; kullanıcı liste yeniden yüklenince geri gelir.
